nodes.description: Public address state variable `dead` initialized to address(0); it is never used by any function and acts only as a sentinel/placeholder.

Public address state variable `owner`, the privileged account. Set to msg.sender in the constructor and overwritten by transferOwnership; used as recipient of token transfers and as the access-control subject in onlyOwner.
Public IERC20 state variable `dpr`, the token contract instance targeted by safeTransfer calls in to_dead and withdraw.
Constructor(address _dpr): assigns the token instance to `dpr` and assigns `owner = msg.sender`, establishing the privileged account.
to_dead(uint256 _amount) external onlyOwner: performs dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount), an external token call made by a privileged caller.
withdraw(uint256 _amount) external onlyOwner: performs dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount), an external token call made by a privileged caller.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) external onlyOwner: overwrites `owner` with the caller-supplied _newOwner, transferring all privileges.
msg.sender: external caller identity. Used as the initial owner in the constructor and as the authorisation subject in the onlyOwner modifier of every privileged function.
External call dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount) inside to_dead: invokes an attacker-influenceable token contract before any state finalisation, enabling re-entrant control flow.
External call dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount) inside withdraw: invokes an attacker-influenceable token contract, enabling re-entrant control flow.
Constructor parameter `_dpr` (address of the ERC20 token), cast to IERC20 and stored into state variable `dpr`.
Parameter `_amount` of to_dead, forwarded verbatim into dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount).
Parameter `_amount` of withdraw, forwarded verbatim into dpr.safeTransfer(owner, _amount).
Parameter `_newOwner` of transferOwnership, written directly into the privileged state variable `owner`.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the untrusted caller becomes the privileged account whose identity is later compared in onlyOwner.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before to_dead executes; msg.sender is the sole authorisation condition for this external token transfer entry point.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before withdraw executes; msg.sender gates the privileged token transfer.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes, gating ownership handover.
The token instance stored in state variable dpr is the callee of the safeTransfer invocation inside to_dead.
The token instance stored in state variable dpr is the callee of the safeTransfer invocation inside withdraw.
State variable owner is passed as the recipient argument of dpr.safeTransfer inside to_dead.
State variable owner is passed as the recipient argument of dpr.safeTransfer inside withdraw.
to_dead transfers control to the external token contract via safeTransfer without any reentrancy guard.
withdraw transfers control to the external token contract via safeTransfer without any reentrancy guard.
The external token call performed by safeTransfer can call back into to_dead before the outer invocation completes, since no state flag or mutex protects the function.
The external token call performed by safeTransfer can call back into withdraw before the outer invocation completes, since no state flag or mutex protects the function.
A malicious token invoked by to_dead's safeTransfer can re-enter withdraw, the sibling privileged token-transfer function, in the same transaction.
Constructor parameter _dpr is cast to IERC20 and written into state variable dpr.
Constructor function consumes the external _dpr argument and uses it as the token address.
Parameter _amount of to_dead flows directly into the external safeTransfer call as the transferred value.
Parameter _amount of withdraw flows directly into the external safeTransfer call as the transferred value.
Parameter _newOwner is written into the privileged state variable owner, handing full control of the contract to the supplied address.
Parameter _newOwner is the sole input consumed by transferOwnership.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter _dpr is a transient local view of the token address whose only semantic effect is initialising state variable dpr (node 2) within the constructor (node 3); it should be normalised into the constructor rather than modelled independently.

The parameter _amount of to_dead carries no independent semantics: it is passed unmodified as the value argument of the unsafe external call dpr.safeTransfer (node 8), so it should be merged into that unsafe_operation.

The parameter _amount of withdraw carries no independent semantics: it is passed unmodified as the value argument of the unsafe external call dpr.safeTransfer (node 9), so it should be merged into that unsafe_operation.

The parameter _newOwner is a transient argument of transferOwnership (node 6) whose only effect is overwriting the privileged owner state variable; it should be normalised into the function that writes it.
